title: Final Project Data Mining - Credit Card Fraud Detection
summary: A student final-project notebook comparing baseline, SMOTE, and CTGAN-based oversampling strategies to address class imbalance in credit card fraud detection with Random Forest and XGBoost classifiers. It uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer, fit on minority-class fraud data via SingleTableMetadata, to generate synthetic fraud samples for data augmentation.
evidence: FinalProjectDatmin.ipynb:479 'from sdv.single_table import CTGANSynthesizer' used to fit CTGAN on fraud subset and generate synthetic samples
